newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium futures hit limit-lows on dlr fall.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium futures hit limit-lows on dlr fall.

text.p: Tokyo aluminium futures slumped to limit-lows across the board on Monday morning as the dollar dropped to a near four month low against the yen, traders said.

By 0041 GMT, benchmark October 1998 slightly recovered to trade at 199.9 yen per kg, down 5.9 yen from the close on Friday. The February contract was down 5.1 yen at 203.9 yen after hitting its limit-low. October 1997 and December 1997 were at their limit-lows.
Estimated volume so far was 2,477 lots, compared with 2,974 lots for the whole of Friday.
